title: An even number of a's and an even number of b's
notes: Each state name says whether the a's (first letter) and the b's (second letter) so far are even or odd. An a flips the first letter and a b the second. abba ends back in ee and is accepted; aba ends in eo.
ops: start ee; accept ee; ee a -> oe; ee b -> eo; oe a -> ee; oe b -> oo; eo a -> oo; eo b -> ee; oo a -> eo; oo b -> oe
